projects.title: PRAM
projects.description:
PRAM (Progressively Replacing Auction Mobility) builds Bonhams' own in-house bidding engine, taking control of the end-to-end customer experience and improving efficiency for both customers and staff.

Components:
- New Bonhams App: mobile app supporting both Bonhams' (BBE) and Auction Mobility (AM) auctions; AM only until that contract ends.
- Registration Engine: backoffice tool for CS/SD teams to manage registrations and bids for online and live auctions.
- Online auctions: bidding engine plus lot & auction details pages (web + app).
- Live auctions: bidding engine, lot & auction details pages, customer-facing live bidding page (web + app), Auction Room Display (projector / public bulletin), Clerk Console (clerks during live auctions) and Auctioneer Console (auctioneer screen).
projects.impact: Cost savings of ~£1M/year. See attachments for additional full list of benefits for PRAM.
